cards.title: Local verification
items: Validate input before reading the exact-key volatile geocode cache.
Run all recorded S02 wire cases, including aliases, errors, HEAD, 304 and preflight.
Measure cold/warm one- and two-provider mock bursts and distinct-key demand.

cards.title: Privacy and ownership
items: Precise reverse-geocode results and lookup history stay in bounded volatile RAM.
S3 address caching is optional; coarse reverse labels require separate exact-parity proof.
A waiter owns its response deadline, while a shared job owns its bounded acquisition and reservation.

cards.title: Activation remains separate
items: Reuse the existing operator-injected geocoder environment; this diagram contains no keys.
Actual daily and peak provider quotas remain unknown. Local mock results do not accept those gates.
Production family activation needs parity, seven-day paired shadow, measured latency, quota headroom and AK cutover authority.
